meta.prompt: Help me pick a laptop with a short question flow, one question at a time, with progress (Question 1 of 3) and a Back button. Question 1: what I use it for (School or study, Work and office, Gaming, Creative projects). Question 2 depends on it: for Gaming ask "What do you play?" with Competitive esports or Big open-world titles; otherwise ask what matters most (All-day battery, A big screen and keyboard, As light as possible). Question 3: budget (Under $800, $800 to $1,500, Over $1,500). End on one recommendation with two reasons that repeat my answers and a Start over button: Gaming gets the Volt 16 Gaming at $1,399, Creative projects the Studio 14 Pro at $1,799, and anyone else the Slate 13 at $649 if the budget is under $800, otherwise the Aero 14 at $1,099.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Find your laptop" "A few quick questions" icon:"laptop_mac" status:"Question {step} of 3" w:390
  state step=1
  state use=""
  state second=""
  state budget=""
  if step<=3
    Steps steps:["Use","Focus","Budget"] current:=step
  if step==1
    OptionList "What will you use it for?" =use options:["School or study","Work and office","Gaming","Creative projects"] -> step=2
  if step==2
    if use=="Gaming"
      OptionList "What do you play?" =second options:["Competitive esports","Big open-world titles"] -> step=3
    if use!="Gaming"
      OptionList "What matters most?" =second options:["All-day battery","A big screen and keyboard","As light as possible"] -> step=3
  if step==3
    OptionList "What is your budget?" =budget options:["Under $800","$800 to $1,500","Over $1,500"] -> step=4
  if step==4
    if use=="Gaming"
      Recommendation "Volt 16 Gaming" "$1,399. Built for what you play." reasons:["You'll use it for {use}","You chose: {second}","Budget: {budget}"] eyebrow:"Best match" kind:"laptop"
    if use=="Creative projects"
      Recommendation "Studio 14 Pro" "$1,799. Built for creative work." reasons:["You'll use it for {use}","You chose: {second}","Budget: {budget}"] eyebrow:"Best match" kind:"laptop"
    if use!="Gaming" && use!="Creative projects"
      if budget=="Under $800"
        Recommendation "Slate 13" "$649. Fits a tighter budget." reasons:["You'll use it for {use}","You said {second} matters most"] eyebrow:"Best match" kind:"laptop"
      if budget!="Under $800"
        Recommendation "Aero 14" "$1,099. A strong all-rounder." reasons:["You'll use it for {use}","You said {second} matters most"] eyebrow:"Best match" kind:"laptop"
  Row gap:10
    if step>1 && step<4
      ActionButton "Back" tone:quiet -> step=step-1
    if step==4
      ActionButton "Start over" tone:primary -> step=1; use=""; second=""; budget=""
